column3: NKJV has “supper being ended” and “Judas Iscariot, Simon's son,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “during supper” and “that Judas … should betray Him.”
NKJV has “He who eats bread with Me,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “He who eats My bread.”
NKJV has “I shall give a piece of bread when I have dipped it,” following the Textus Receptus wording; the critical text reads “I will dip the piece of bread and give it to him.”
